environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'reporting-prod' with PodSecurity admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile. Container entrypoint executes pivot_root(2) into /srv/app (bind-mounted read-only from initContainer-prepared ephemeral volume containing only application code and Python runtime). The post-pivot filesystem has /proc mounted with hidepid=2 and subset=pid. No /etc/shadow, no service account token volume projection (automountServiceAccountToken: false in ServiceAccount spec), and /proc/self/environ returns only GRPC_PORT and PYTHONPATH. Additionally, the container runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, and capabilities dropped to empty set. The seccomp profile is RuntimeDefault which permits basic syscalls but the chroot'd filesystem contains no useful targets for exfiltration even if template injection achieves code execution.
